title: The last ruled sheet
logline: The last sheet with blue-pencil tiers on it, found under the table, used as a drop cloth: paint on the ruling. The grid's end, drawn as a stain.

panels.composition: Close on a sheet of Arches on the garage floor, three tiers ruled in blue pencil, and across the ruling a spill of ochre wash and the ring of a jar — used as a drop cloth. The ruling shows through the stain. Nothing else on the page.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a close view of a watercolor sheet on a concrete floor ruled into three tiers in faint blue pencil with an ochre paint spill and a jar's ring stained across the ruling, no words
image.notes: The grid under the stain. Keep the blue lines faintly legible.

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The grid, ended as a drop cloth.
